Many proponents of decentralized finance (DeFi) highlight how it removes costly intermediaries from financial transactions, yet the following sentence may confuse readers:

"Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms use smart contracts, which can automatically enforce transaction rules, they simultaneously help users avoid certain traditional banking fees."

Which choice best revises the sentence so that any pronouns and modifiers clearly refer to the intended nouns?
choices:
A. Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms, by using smart contracts, which can automatically enforce transaction rules, help users avoid certain traditional banking fees, they say.
B. Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms, by using smart contracts that automatically enforce transaction rules, helping users avoid certain traditional banking fees, display many benefits.
C. Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms use smart contracts, which can automatically enforce transaction rules and might help users, those fees get significantly reduced.
D. Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms use smart contracts that can automatically enforce transaction rules and simultaneously help users avoid certain traditional banking fees.
explanation: Answer choice D clearly connects the modifier "that can automatically enforce transaction rules" to "smart contracts," thereby clarifying who or what performs each action. The sentence avoids vague pronouns and places the descriptions in a way that shows how using smart contracts helps DeFi users avoid traditional financial fees. By contrast, the other options create confusion or awkward breaks in the sentence, resulting in uncertain references and modifiers that do not clearly point to "smart contracts" or "platforms."

• Content & Objective: The question clearly explains that the original sentence is confusing and asks which revision best fixes the modifier/pronoun error. The answer choices (with D designated as correct) are clear and include three plausible distractors. However, while the subject matter (decentralized finance) is current, ensure that all students understand the context or consider simplifying the topic if needed for an “Easy” difficulty question.

• Formatting & Structure: According to the guidelines, every SAT question in this category must begin with a sentence that includes a blank formatted as exactly “ ________ ” (8 spaces) to indicate where the answer choice would be inserted. Currently, the question provides a full sentence with no such blank and then asks, “Which choice best revises the sentence…?” To comply with SAT practice standards, revise the stem so that the sentence contains a blank. For example, you might rewrite the sentence as follows:

  “Decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms use smart contracts ________ help users avoid certain traditional banking fees.”

Then follow with:
  “Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?”

This change makes it immediately clear where the revision is meant to occur, keeping the format consistent with other SAT questions on Pronouns and Modifiers.

• Explanation: The explanation correctly identifies that answer D appropriately attaches the modifier “that can automatically enforce transaction rules” to “smart contracts” and clarifies the intended meaning. It would be even more helpful if the explanation briefly mentioned why the other options fail (for example, creating awkward phrasing or misplacing modifiers).

• Recommendations: 
 1. Insert an 8‑space blank (i.e. “ ________ ”) in the main sentence where the answer choice would be placed.
 2. Adjust the follow‐up question to begin with “Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?” (rather than “best revises…”) so that it mirrors the standard SAT format.
 3. (Optional) Expand the explanation slightly to note why the other choices produce errors in pronoun or modifier placement.

Once these formatting adjustments are made, the question will fully adhere to the SAT guidelines for Pronouns and Modifiers practice questions at the Easy difficulty level.

D. Observations suggest that environmental factors mildly influence an individual’s likelihood of developing certain traits if there is no related family history.
